chunks.title: Contact Mohabbat
chunks.heading: Contact Mohabbat
chunks.text:
To contact Mohabbat, use the contact form on this page: write a name, an email address and a message, and it lands in his inbox. He replies to the email address you give. You can also email him directly at mohabbat.bd2020@gmail.com.

Whether he is available for work or hiring is not stated on this site, so ask him through the form or by email.

He is also on GitHub (https://github.com/andrew-velox), LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohabbatvlx/) and X (https://x.com/mohabbat__vlx). His resume (CV) is at /Mohabbat_s_Resume_2026.pdf.

chunks.title: About Mohabbat
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › About Mohabbat
chunks.text: Mohabbat is a software engineer. Where does Mohabbat study? He studies at Green University of Bangladesh, where he is a student pursuing a BSc (bachelor's degree) in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), his education. His main languages are Rust, Zig, Python, TypeScript and JavaScript. He is a core contributor to Ziex, a full-stack web framework for Zig. His GitHub username is Andrew-Velox.

chunks.title: Resume
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Resume
chunks.text: Mohabbat's resume (CV) is a PDF. Use the "Resume / CV" button at the top of the home page, or open it directly at /Mohabbat_s_Resume_2026.pdf.

chunks.title: Experience
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Experience
chunks.text:
Mohabbat is a Software Developer and Core Contributor at Ziex, a full-stack web framework for Zig. It is remote work, from January 2026 to the present. The technologies are Zig, JSX, AST, DevTools, Windows and Linux.

• He built the Ziex DevTools Chrome extension using Zig and Ziex, across 14 merged pull requests and more than 3,200 lines. It has component inspection, props viewing, search and native-element visibility controls.
• He designed a port-based communication layer between DevTools and the application runtime, with hover highlighting, click-to-scroll, a configurable host input and dark mode.
• He fixed 6 zx toolchain bugs with regression tests, and added 2 benchmark suites (more than 1,280 lines across 32 files), 2 deployment templates and a server retry fix.

chunks.title: Open source
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Open source
chunks.text: What is Ziex? Ziex is a full-stack web framework for Zig. It puts HTML syntax directly inside Zig code, like JSX but for Zig. Mohabbat is a core contributor to it (ziex-dev/ziex on GitHub, https://github.com/ziex-dev/ziex), as open source work.

chunks.title: Projects
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Projects
chunks.text: The projects Mohabbat has built are AnimFetch, Ziex Devtools, RAG Content Platform, Meow Chat, Mew Shop, CF Fetcher and the GUCC Website AI Chatbot. They cover terminal tools written in Rust, browser extensions, backend systems with AI and RAG, and full-stack web apps with Django and Next.js. His best-known project is AnimFetch, his most-starred own repository on GitHub. Each project has its own entry below, and the project cards on the home page have images, links and a details view.

chunks.title: AnimFetch
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Projects › AnimFetch
chunks.text: AnimFetch is an animated system fetch that you can work inside, written in Rust by Mohabbat. The ASCII art stays pinned at the top of the terminal while your prompt and command output scroll below it. It ships with 18 animations (cats, foxes, planets, a black hole and more), runs on Linux and macOS, and has zero dependencies. Tags: Rust, CLI, Terminal, Linux, macOS. Package: https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/animfetch-bin. Code: https://github.com/Andrew-Velox/animfetch.

chunks.title: Ziex Devtools
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Projects › Ziex Devtools
chunks.text: Ziex DevTools is a browser extension that Mohabbat built for debugging applications made with the Ziex web framework for Zig. It integrates into the browser's developer console and gives a clear, real-time look at the application's state and performance. Tags: Zig, Browser Extension, Debugging, Ziex Framework. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/efnedneccooengjfmahlnmicgkalnopj. Code: https://github.com/ziex-dev/ziex/tree/main/ide/devtool.

chunks.title: RAG Content Platform
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Projects › RAG Content Platform
chunks.text: The RAG Content Platform is an advanced backend system by Mohabbat, powered by RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). It indexes blogs in a vector database for interactive question answering, and includes a private study assistant that summarizes documents. It is built as a central API for web and mobile apps. Tags: RAG, Vector DB, LLM, Python, REST API, AI/ML. Code: https://github.com/Andrew-Velox/Mega-Project.

chunks.title: Meow Chat
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Projects › Meow Chat
chunks.text: Meow Chat is a modern, Discord-inspired real-time chat application by Mohabbat, built with Django and WebSockets. It supports private messages, group conversations and file sharing, with a polished dark theme. Tags: Django, Webhook, HTMX, n8n, AI APIs. Live demo: https://meow-chat-7qic.onrender.com/ (demo login: user1 / demo1234). Code: https://github.com/Andrew-Velox/Meow-Chat.

chunks.title: Mew Shop
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Projects › Mew Shop
chunks.text: Mew Shop is a modern, responsive Next.js shop website by Mohabbat, with a full navigation bar, an engaging home page and an SEO-friendly structure. It is prepared to connect to a Django backend API. Tags: Django, DRF, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS. Live site: https://mew-shop-eight.vercel.app/. Code: https://github.com/Andrew-Velox/mew_shop.

chunks.title: CF Fetcher
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Projects › CF Fetcher
chunks.text: CF Fetcher is a Chrome extension by Mohabbat that fetches a user's accepted Codeforces submissions and puts them in a ZIP file of README.md files organized by rating. The ZIP can be uploaded to a GitHub repository to show off problem-solving work. Tags: Python, JavaScript, HTML. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/cf-fetcher/pehfoogjijedipaehbibmjcajbcbimef. Code: https://github.com/Andrew-Velox/Codeforces-Submission-Fetcher-Extension.

chunks.title: GUCC Website AI Chatbot
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Projects › GUCC Website AI Chatbot
chunks.text: Mohabbat contributed a RAG-based AI chatbot to the website of his university's computer club (Green University Computer Club, GUCC). The club president uploads documents in the Django admin panel, they are indexed automatically into a vector database, and the chatbot answers questions from that content. Tags: RAG, Django, Vector DB, LLM, Python. Website: https://gucc.green.edu.bd/. Code: https://github.com/GreenUniversityComputerClub.

chunks.title: Skills
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › Skills
chunks.text:
Mohabbat's skills and tech stack. Does he know Rust? Yes: he knows Rust, Zig, Python, TypeScript and JavaScript, builds web apps with React, Next.js and Django, and has experience with AI (RAG, LLMs and vector databases). By area:

• Languages: Rust, Zig, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript.
• Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS.
• Backend: Django, REST APIs, WebSockets.
• Database: PostgreSQL, Vector DB.
• AI: RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) and LLMs.
• Tools: Docker, GitHub, Linux.

chunks.title: Selected repositories
chunks.heading: Mohabbat's portfolio › GitHub › Selected repositories
chunks.text: The repositories Mohabbat has selected to show on his home page are animfetch, ziex, codeforces-stats, CF Submission Fetcher, awesome-zig-llm and rust-user-map. codeforces-stats is a terminal TUI for tracking Codeforces problem solving, ratings, submissions and contest performance. awesome-zig-llm is a curated list of LLM, machine learning and AI projects built with Zig. rust-user-map is a community world map where developers pin their locations. ziex is the Zig web framework he contributes to.
